symptom: No refs row ever had TargetType SNIPPET: every snippet call was recorded as a show_page edge to a PAGE (FactoryManagement 11.16: 311 of them, 22 from layouts), so an architecture report concluded the catalog records no references from layouts and a query for snippet usage by type found nothing.
cause: scanWidgetAllRefs collected every "Form" string as a page; a Forms$SnippetCall stores its snippet under "Form" too, the same Form-means-page rename as ShowFormAction.
insight: `mxcli refs <snippet>` matches on TargetName only, so it listed the callers and hid the mislabel; query by TargetType (or join refs to snippets_data on TargetName and group by RefKind) to see it. The mislabel had a dependent: SEC012 walked into snippets only because they arrived as show_page/PAGE, and its test fixture encoded that shape, so the new kind had to be added to its walk and to show callers or every snippet would read as uncalled. Measured parity after the fix: 0 show_page edges into snippets, the same 35 snippets without any inbound edge, lint identical (254 built-in, 1834 with bundled Starlark).
